images.name: B4
images.prompt: Vertical cinematic film still, photorealistic, ancient Babylon, warm gold and lapis-blue color grade, fine film grain. Keep the lower third darker and calm for text. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. No visible hands. No people. low-angle shot looking up at the subject, towering over the camera, sky and buildings converging behind. lit only by candle or a single practical lamp, warm pool of light, darkness around. A heavy bronze-bound treasure chest with a large iron lock in a closed underground stone vault lit only by two burning wall torches. No windows, no openings, no lamps, no electric lights, no modern objects.
